result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, and PandaDoc** are the strongest e-signature options. The best choice depends on whether you simply need customers to sign documents or want a more complete system for contracts, proposals, and sales workflows.

My initial recommendation: **Dropbox Sign for simplicity and value, DocuSign for reliability and integrations, and PandaDoc for an all-in-one document and sales solution.**

## Best e-signature software compared

| Software | Best for | Main advantage |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Small businesses | Simple, straightforward signing |
| DocuSign | All-round business use | Integrations and reputation |
| PandaDoc | Sales and proposals | Documents, quotes and signatures together |
| Signable | UK small businesses | UK-based provider and flexible pricing |
| Adobe Acrobat Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Excellent PDF integration |
| Zoho Sign | Budget-conscious teams | Good fit with Zoho applications |


### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — best for simplicity**

- Easy to send and sign contracts.
- Reusable templates and audit trails.
- Good for freelancers and small teams.
- Particularly convenient if you use Dropbox.

Pricing varies by plan and billing period.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — best overall**

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong integrations with business software.
- Templates, reminders and signing workflows.
- Good as your business grows.

[Visit DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc — best for sales documents**

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when clients view documents.
- Manage the process from proposal to signature.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

Other noteworthy options\:

- **Signable\:** Worth considering if you are UK-based and want account-based pricing. [Website](https://www.signable.co.uk/)\.
- **Zoho Sign\:** Worth considering if you already use Zoho. [Website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)\.
- **Adobe Acrobat Sign\:** Best if you regularly edit and manage PDFs. [Website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature-software.html)\.

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons; prices and document limits should be checked against the live plans. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What to look for before buying

For a small business, I would prioritise\:

1. **Unlimited or sufficient signature requests** – avoid unexpected costs as your business grows.
2. **Reusable templates** – save time on recurring contracts.
3. **Audit trails** – evidence of who signed, when and how.
4. **Automatic reminders** – chase unsigned contracts without doing it manually.
5. **GDPR and UK data protection** – check data processing terms, retention and hosting arrangements.
6. **Multi-user access** – make sure the pricing works if several employees need to send documents.

In the UK, electronic signatures are generally valid for most commercial agreements, although certain document types have additional requirements. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
